arStrings.szText: “Blood grants sight. Blood grants certainty.” It’s carved above an urn beneath the Sanctum of the Eye. A relic from the ancient Oracles.
Rumors said you could see your future if you offered your blood to the urn.
Nothing happened, until...the urns appeared. Woke the next morning to find them next to our beds. Our deaths painted in blood. Our blood.
That could be goat’s blood! It’s a prank, at best! I bet Lycus is pissing himself laughing right now.
And Desdemona? Is she in on this? Both sides of her?
